support.heading: Everything here is yours to use
message: Every video, report, summary, quiz, infographic, and slide deck on 21st Memory is open to watch and share. Download the files from Telegram. Nothing is locked, and support never unlocks anything.

The source material comes from the original Thalon Thor / Christian21 transmissions. The work here is organizing and presenting that material in clearer formats using AI tools, then pointing back to the originals.
Those tools, along with internet and power, have ongoing costs. A gift is optional. It helps cover them so new material can keep being made.
Where support goes: power, internet, and the AI subscriptions used to make the videos and pages. That’s it. If those aren’t covered, new material slows.
